i.norm: Verifies that {@link StrMatcher.StringMatcher#isMatch(char[], int, int, int)} returns 0 (no match) when only the first character of the target string lines up with the buffer and the following characters differ.
Buffer where only index 1 holds 'T'; the other slots stay as the default '\0'.
Matching starts at index 1: 'T' matches, but the next stored char 'h' does not match buffer[2] ('\0'), so the matcher reports no match.
